invariants.rationale: Partition path is likely required for identifying the correct partition and is passed to downstream methods.
fileId is used directly in logging and downstream processing; it being null could result in exceptions.
recordItr is passed to file-handle and super methods; null iterators may cause NullPointerException.
A file id should not be an empty string for identifying files.
Partition path should not be empty, as it is used for data routing.
